cohort: 1443 singleton pregnancies with fetal anatomy ultrasound between 2011-2013
finding: Shorter PCI distance was significantly associated with NICU admission, but not with preterm birth, pre-eclampsia, PPH, or cesarean delivery, and was not predictive of FGR.
mod_finding: The study found no association between placental cord insertion distance and cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific range not provided
